item.text: Проект пустой, поэтому создаю реализацию и README с нуля. Сразу закладываю строгую CSV-валидацию, точную Decimal-агрегацию и предсказуемые ошибки CLI.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -m py_compile main.py
python3 - <<'PY'
import csv
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
main = root / \"main.py\"

def run(path, *args):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(main), str(path), *args], text=True, capture_output=True)

def expect(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(message)

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    td = Path(td)
    source = td / \"input.csv\"
    source.write_text('team,note,amount\\r\\nB,\"hello, world\",1.20\\r\\nA,\"line 1\\nline 2\",2.30\\r\\nA,x,0.70\\r\\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='')
    original = source.read_bytes()

    p = run(source)
    expect(p.returncode == 0, p.stderr)
    data = json.loads(p.stdout)
    expect(data == [
        {'team':'B','note':'hello, world','amount':'1.20'},
        {'team':'A','note':'line 1\\nline 2','amount':'2.30'},
        {'team':'A','note':'x','amount':'0.70'},
    ], data)

    p = run(source, '--where', 'team=A', '--where', 'note=x', '--output', 'csv')
    expect(p.returncode == 0, p.stderr)
    expect(list(csv.reader(p.stdout.splitlines())) == [['team','note','amount'],['A','x','0.70']], p.stdout)

    p = run(source, '--group-by', 'team', '--sum', 'amount', '--avg', 'amount')
    expect(p.returncode == 0, p.stderr)
    expect(json.loads(p.stdout) == [
        {'team':'A','sum_amount':'3','avg_amount':'1.5'},
        {'team':'B','sum_amount':'1.2','avg_amount':'1.2'},
    ], p.stdout)
    expect(source.read_bytes() == original, 'input was modified')

    bad_cases = {
        'duplicate.csv': ('a,a\\n1,2\\n', [], 'duplicate'),
        'empty-header.csv': (',b\\n1,2\\n', [], 'empty'),
        'short.csv': ('a,b\\n1\\n', [], 'row 2'),
        'invalid-number.csv': ('g,n\\na,nope\\n', ['--group-by','g','--sum','n'], 'row 2'),
        'blank-number.csv': ('g,n\\na,\\n', ['--group-by','g','--avg','n'], 'row 2'),
        'bad-quote.csv': ('a,b\\n\"x,y\\n', [], 'malformed'),
    }
    for filename, (body, args, fragment) in bad_cases.items():
        path = td / filename
        path.write_text(body, encoding='utf-8', newline='')
        p = run(path, *args)
        expect(p.returncode "'!= 0, f'"'{filename} unexpectedly succeeded: {p.stdout}')
        expect(fragment.lower() in p.stderr.lower(), (filename, p.stderr))

    p = run(source, '--where', 'missing=x')
    expect(p.returncode "'!= 0 and '"'unknown column' in p.stderr.lower(), p.stderr)
    p = run(source, '--where', 'broken')
    expect(p.returncode "'!= 0 and '"'malformed filter' in p.stderr.lower(), p.stderr)
    p = run(source, '--sum', 'amount')
    expect(p.returncode "'!= 0 and '"'require' in p.stderr.lower(), p.stderr)

print('all focused self-tests passed')
PY
sed -n '1,260p' main.py
sed -n '1,220p' README.md"
